name: Lancaster

licensing.selective: No selective licensing scheme: after consulting on a scheme for Morecambe's West End (parts of Harbour and Heysham North wards), the council's Cabinet decided on 16 April 2024 not to go ahead, choosing targeted enforcement and a Good Landlords Charter instead.
licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: the West End proposal also included additional licensing, which was not taken forward. Mandatory licensing applies across the district to HMOs with five or more people from two or more households.

housing: Lancaster district takes in the historic city of Lancaster, the seaside town of Morecambe, Heysham and Carnforth, and rural villages up the Lune valley and around the Forest of Bowland. Lancaster has stone Georgian and Victorian housing and a large student market for its two universities, with shared terraces in Bowerham, Scotforth and Freehold. Morecambe's West End has many large Victorian houses and former guest houses split into flats and bedsits, where the council consulted on licensing. Private renting is above the North West average.
checkinTips: Student shared houses in Bowerham, Scotforth and Freehold: photograph each bedroom's lock and furniture, fire doors, alarms and the kitchen appliances.
Former guest houses converted into flats in Morecambe's West End: photograph each flat's door, meters, fire doors and alarms, and the shared hallway.
Seafront homes in Morecambe and Heysham: look for salt corrosion on window frames and outside metalwork, and damp on exposed walls.
Stone terraces in Lancaster: look for damp on thick walls and in cellars, and record sash windows and chimneys.
Homes near the Lune and in low-lying parts of the coast: look for signs of past flooding or damp in ground-floor rooms.
Rural stone cottages in the Lune valley: photograph the oil or LPG tank, any septic tank or private water supply, and wood burners.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems in a private let can contact Lancaster City Council's private housing (health and housing) team, after first reporting the problem to their landlord.
